newsitem.title: USA: Vista 2000 to issue shrs in settlement.
newsitem.headline: Vista 2000 to issue shrs in settlement.

text.p: Vista 2000 Inc said on Wednesday it has reached an agreement in principle to settle a consolidated class action shareholder lawsuit.
The class action lawsuits were brought on behalf of purchasers of Vista shares and warrants between October 24, 1994 and June 8, 1996, Vista said.
The lawsuits alleged securities laws violations by the company and former officers, directors and outside auditors.

Vista said the settlement provides, among other things, that Vista will issue shares of its common stock to the plaintiffs and the class in order to convey ownership of 4O percent of the common stock of the company.
Vista's insurance carrier will contribute $300,000 to the settlement, the company said.
The settlement would become effective upon court approval, Vista said.
